patterns.name: unauthorized_admin_group_addition
conditions: T1078 present; ordinary account added to administrators and promptly used privileged commands; level >=10
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1078 describes abuse of valid accounts; unexpected privileged-group membership is a strong account-abuse signal.

patterns.name: privilege_escalation_abuse
conditions: T1068 present; elevated session or administrator commands from unfamiliar address; level >=10
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1068 covers exploitation for privilege escalation; high-severity elevation paired with unfamiliar activity warrants containment.

patterns.name: after_hours_privileged_activity
conditions: activity outside expected hours plus administrator-group change or privileged command; level >=10
patterns.evidence: Unexpected privileged activity outside expected hours is contextual evidence, but not proof of compromise by itself.

patterns.name: ambiguous_privilege_change
conditions: T1068 or T1078 present with partial, repeated, failed, or uncorroborated privilege action; level >=5
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1068 and T1078 cover privilege escalation and valid-account abuse; incomplete evidence should alert rather than automatically contain.
